mapper.select: SELECT client_idx, org_code, org_name, client_id, client_secret, redirect_uri, created_at FROM mock_clients WHERE client_id = #{clientId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mock_authorizations ( ci, org_code, code, app_scheme, is_used, expires_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{ci}, #{orgCode}, #{code}, #{appScheme}, #{isUsed}, #{expiresAt}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT connection_id, ci, org_code, code, app_scheme, is_used, expires_at, created_at FROM mock_authorizations WHERE code = #{code}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mock_transactions ( x_api_tran_id, connection_id, state, api_url, created_at ) VALUES ( #{xApiTranId}, #{connectionId}, #{state}, #{apiUrl}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mock_transactions WHERE x_api_tran_id = #{tranId}
